vocabulary.definition: the action of subduing someone or something by force
vocabulary.example: The regime used repression to control any form of dissent.

vocabulary.definition: a small group of people having control of a country, organization, or institution
vocabulary.example: The oligarchy made decisions that favored the elite at the expense of the general population.

vocabulary.definition: take hold of suddenly and forcibly
vocabulary.example: The rebels tried to seize control of the government buildings.

vocabulary.definition: relating to a system of government that is centralized and dictatorial and requires complete subservience to the state
vocabulary.example: Under the totalitarian regime, citizens had no freedom of speech.

vocabulary.definition: a period of violence during which those in power seek to eliminate opposition
vocabulary.example: The dictator's reign of terror resulted in widespread fear among the population.

vocabulary.definition: living forever; never dying or decaying
vocabulary.example: Legends often depict vampires as immortal beings.
